powerControlInventory.reason: Tier measures intrinsic ability, not mastery; inventory frozen, no automatic Tier-to-mastery conversion.

runtime.sizeInput: Frozen Size plan and its recorded draw with matching owner identity. No transformation Size.
runtime.freeze: Identity/source IDs, selected hidden profiles, model, role/event likelihoods, Size/reference/shift, inventory, hard guards, prior, posterior and minimum/maximum bounds and bounded odds saved before external RNG. Fixed plans preserve guarantee/source, base9 and no sampled attempts; replay original saved resolution mode.
runtime.replay: Resolve saved plans without recomputing current parameters. Caller persists plans/draws and consumes source keys atomically.
pending: Final Enchant queues and aggregate Lucky Number/Pawn settlement.

unmodeledContextPolicy: Record unmatched event sources without guessing numeric effects. Explicit likelihoods can be added; plain narrator text, victim/army identities, follower counts, final bonus ledgers and power-tier metadata are not automatically converted to parameters.

probabilityBounds.scope: Only eligible actual raw stat/mastery outcomes, including each Resilient attempt.
probabilityBounds.algorithm: p(i)=minimum+min(lambda*weight(i),maximum-minimum); solve shared lambda in log space so total=1, preserving free-sector excess odds ratios above the floor.
probabilityBounds.feasibility: N*minimum<=1<=N*maximum; hard-excluded outcomes never receive the floor.
probabilityBounds.history: God original template stays an unbounded prior; every new final wheel uses the new bounds. Saved previous plans retain frozen probabilities.

maximumGuaranteeContract.scope: Actual committed maximum guarantees for stats or mastery skip the random wheel.
maximumGuaranteeContract.God: Actual God subtype fixes the one shared Power Mastery base9 for all owned present/future powers, including Authority, Divine and ordinary grants.
maximumGuaranteeContract.VesselGod: God patron at compatibility60/70/80/90/100 inherits the existing maximum guarantee; all owned Power Mastery base9. Lower bands and demon patron do not qualify.
maximumGuaranteeContract.Lich: Committed Lich fixes Durability base9; no singleton100% spin in new runs.
maximumGuaranteeContract.notGuarantees: High lore probability, intrinsic Tier5, matching power names and Kinnara minimumMaster are not maximum guarantees.
maximumGuaranteeContract.timing: Check owned inventory/guarantee before RNG; fixed base then applicable bonuses/debuffs only at finalize. Final scores remain signed/unbounded.
maximumGuaranteeContract.hooks: No random sample, actual attempt, spin ID, Lucky hit, Resilient retry, Double/Nothing decision or sampled Pawn category for automatic bases.
maximumGuaranteeContract.precedence: Explicit maximum before random shaping/Equalizer/Gambler. Contradictory hard exclusions require configuration. Empty power inventory creates no phantom mastery.
maximumGuaranteeContract.history: Existing frozen actual God/ordinary mastery and Lich singleton draws replay unchanged; no retroactive guarantee rewriting.

powerContextRegistryAddition.policy: Append currently canonical themed outcome IDs to existing owner-context caller wheels; retain every old ID, frozen prior/calibration/version unchanged. No new caller permission or stat shift.
